findings.title: Insufficient Training Frequency
findings.clinicalExplanation: Not training frequently enough to stimulate optimal muscle growth.
findings.userExplanation: You are not training frequently enough to stimulate optimal muscle growth.

findings.title: Lack of Progressive Overload
findings.clinicalExplanation: Muscles have adapted to routine. Need to increase challenge to trigger new growth.
findings.userExplanation: Your muscles have adapted to your routine. You need to increase the challenge to trigger new growth.

findings.title: Low Daily Protein
findings.clinicalExplanation: Body doesn't have enough building blocks to synthesize new muscle tissue.
findings.userExplanation: Your body doesn't have enough building blocks to synthesize new muscle tissue.

findings.title: Missing Post-Workout Protein
findings.clinicalExplanation: Missing the critical recovery window to kickstart muscle repair after training.
findings.userExplanation: You are missing the critical recovery window to kickstart muscle repair after training.

findings.title: Inadequate Caloric Intake
findings.clinicalExplanation: Building muscle requires extra energy. Likely eating at maintenance or in a deficit.
findings.userExplanation: Building muscle requires extra energy. You are likely eating at maintenance or in a deficit.

findings.title: Poor Recovery Capacity
findings.userExplanation: Your muscles grow when you rest, not when you train. Insufficient rest is blunting your progress.

findings.title: High Risk of Overtraining
findings.clinicalExplanation: Training too frequently without adequate rest.
findings.userExplanation: You are training too frequently without adequate rest, risking muscle breakdown instead of growth.

findings.title: Inconsistent Training Routine
findings.clinicalExplanation: Frequent missed workouts disrupt the growth cycle.
findings.userExplanation: Muscle building requires long-term consistency. Frequent missed workouts disrupt the growth cycle.

findings.title: Solid Training Foundation
findings.clinicalExplanation: Built a great habit of regular resistance training.
findings.userExplanation: You have built a great habit of regular resistance training.

findings.title: Excellent Protein Intake
findings.clinicalExplanation: Adequate protein to support recovery and growth.
findings.userExplanation: You are providing your body with adequate protein to support recovery and growth.

findings.title: The Recovery Trap
findings.clinicalExplanation: Training hard but not resting enough, leading to a recovery trap.
findings.userExplanation: You are training hard but not resting enough, leading to a recovery trap where muscle cannot be built.

findings.title: The Missing Fuel
findings.clinicalExplanation: Without a caloric surplus and progressive overload, muscles lack both the signal and the building blocks to grow.
findings.userExplanation: Without a caloric surplus and progressive overload, your muscles lack both the signal and the building blocks to grow.
